fullContent:
Gulmakalanala Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sara (first part); edition 13; 478 – 480. 
 Introduction 
 Gulmakalanala Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of effective herbs and minerals. This formulation is known to treat problems related with doshas vata and kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Suddha Parad – purified mercury 
 Suddha Gandhaka – purified Sulphur 
 Suddha haratala – purified orpiment 
 Tamra bhsama – Calcinated and purified copper 
 Tankana – Sodium biborate 
 Yavaksara – Potassium nitrate 
 Nagarmotha – Cyperus rotundus 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Gajapippali – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Kuth – Saussurea costus 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Sunthi – Zingiber officinale 
 Pitpapra – Fumaria officinalis 
 Apamarga – Achyranthes aspera 
 Patha – Cissampelos pareira 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the herbs in an appropriate amount – number one to five ingredients up to 24 grams, sixth up to 120 grams and seven to twelve number ingredients up to 12 grams. 
 Now mix all above ingredients and keep aside. 
 Made the decoction of the herbs from number 12 to 17 and tincture above herbs mixture with this decoction. 
 After this process, made the pills from their paste by taking the quantity up to 150 mg. 
 
 Dose 
 One to two pills, two times a day, with haritaki’s decoction. 
 Indications 
 
 Uterine tumor 
 Vata and kapha related gulma 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take this medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
